key_path: `npx workos@latest install` (or raw `POST https://api.workos.com/x/one-shot-environments`, no body, no auth), which returns apiKey (sk_test_), clientId, claimToken, authkitDomain
Use the apiKey immediately: full scope, works before any human is involved
Optional, later: `npx workos@latest env claim` mints a nonce, and the human opens dashboard.workos.com/claim?nonce=... to bind it to an account
human_gates: claim step (sign in/sign up) only to make it permanent

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: workos CLI auto-detects agent contexts (CLAUDECODE, CURSOR_AGENT, CODEX_SANDBOX) and emits JSON; gh-style exit codes
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes: remote MCP uses OAuth via WorkOS Connect (consent screen)
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: yes: anonymous one-shot environment API mints a test API key
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: test (sk_test_) environments; org/user API keys product
agent_native_auth.keyless_claimable_dev_mode: yes: canonical example, documented at https://workos.com/auth.md for agents

mcp.docs_mcp: no separate docs MCP; product MCP manages orgs, users, SSO connections, branding
mcp.one_click: no deeplinks found; documented `claude mcp add` / `codex mcp add` one-liners

docs_for_agents.agent_onboarding_doc: https://workos.com/auth.md: an agent-addressed 'how to register a credential' spec with an error/retry table
docs_for_agents.feedback: https://workos.com/docs/feedback.md: a channel for agents to report wrong docs

score_justification: An agent gets a working API key with one unauthenticated POST or CLI command, can claim it later, uses an OAuth remote MCP, and has an auth.md written for agents.
best_practice: auth.md plus one-shot anonymous environments with a claim ceremony: provision now, attach to a human later
biggest_gap: One-shot creds are test-only; production still needs the claim + dashboard. No one-click MCP deeplinks.
enabler_features: AuthKit Agent Registration API (anonymous / service_auth / refresh types, pre_claim vs post_claim scopes, claim ceremony) lets other SaaS offer the same auth.md flow
AuthKit for MCP: authorization server with CIMD (preferred) and DCR fallback
API Keys widget + org/user API keys API
